hub.name: Rattleguard
hub.motd:
You arrived in a majestic ridge city by spelljammer or portal, and promptly found out how expensive rent is when the Mist comes every night and everyone wants permanent safety. Down in the valleys, though, lie the magical crystals that power the rest of the verse—and someone has to collect them. Welcome to Rattleguard, a frontier town perched just below the mistline. Every night the whole town works to keep an unbroken ring of braziers burning. The ring holds, mostly. Spirits still take a few people, but the pay is good and the miners are friendly. The ruins down in the valley are the towns that stopped holding theirs. You're with the Troublesome Company now—recruited when you ran out of coin and jobs up top. Pick a partner, pick a hex, and remember the only rule: be back behind the braziers before dark.

First Night Checklist:
1. Build a Level 3 character on D&D Beyond (your combat sheet & dice live there; your gold, loot, and gear live here) and register them under Characters.
2. Open Town to visit the Troublesome Company Hall, Quartermaster, and Taproom before heading out.
3. Open Maps to scout the fjord valleys and propose or join an expedition on Sessions.

town_locations.name: The Troublesome Company Hall
town_locations.description: A timber-and-slate longhouse warmed by twin brim-coal hearths. Every morning, contractors gather here over burnt coffee to pick a hex, pair up with whoever showed up, and log their departure before the gates open.
services: Pick today's expedition partners & hex destination
Turn in valley crystal crates for Company pay
Leave notes for the next crew on the shared map
town_locations.rumor: Halver wants the great warding bell out of Tarnhollow before Rattleguard's own cracked one gives out.

town_locations.name: Bramwell's Quartermaster Shed
town_locations.description: Crammed floor-to-rafters with weapons, armor, climbing rope, steel traps, and oil flasks. Bramwell doesn't believe in fixed catalogs—if you need something weird, ask nicely or bring him something weirder from the valley.
services: Buy weapons, armor, and adventuring gear
Commission silvering or order something special
Appraise pre-Mist salvage pulled out of the fjords
town_locations.rumor: Bramwell pays double for tools with a Tarnhollow maker's mark. He won't say who he's buying them back for.

town_locations.name: The Brazier Gate & Bell Tower
town_locations.role: Sunset Bells, Mist Watch & Gate Wards
town_locations.description: Rattleguard's fortified river-gate, crowned with iron braziers that roar from dusk until dawn. Every able hand in town takes a turn on the night shift, because the Mist pours through any gap in the ring. The heavy brass bell rings thirty minutes before it rises.
services: Check the evening bell schedule & valley Mist sightings
Sign up for a night shift on the ring
Report missing crews or breaches along the outer wall
town_locations.rumor: Two miners swore the Mist pooled inside a dry limestone cellar at noon yesterday—Vaelen insists it was just a restless spirit.

town_locations.name: The Soot & Canary Taproom
town_locations.description: Loud, smoky, and surprisingly warm. Off-duty crystal miners trade tall tales by the stove while Cartel scouts and Crow's Ledge fences quietly size up anyone who just walked in from the valley.
services: Buy miners a round for uncharted fjord landmarks
Meet Crow's Ledge fences or Cartel brokers off the record
Check faction standing across Highspire and the valleys
town_locations.rumor: A Crow's Ledge courier claims a sky-skiff clipped the trees in the western gorge at dawn—nobody's reached the wreck yet.

town_locations.name: The Highspire Cliff-Lift
town_locations.description: A rattling iron cage slung on greased cables up the sheer 400-foot fjord wall to Highspire. It's the fastest way back above the mistline, and the Cartel prices it so nobody in Rattleguard rides it home every night—if you have a Cartel pass or enough coin to make Warden Krell look the other way.
services: Ride up to Highspire for guild business or safe lodging
Negotiate or bribe your way past Cartel cargo tariffs
Inspect the cliffside view of the First Finger valley
town_locations.rumor: The Cartel doubled lift tariffs overnight; three Rattleguard wagons are stranded at the base waiting for someone to sort it out.

factions.description: Your scrappy, underinsured contractor outfit in Rattleguard. They give you choices, decent pay, and interesting partners to take into the valley each morning—as long as you're back before dark.
A global merchant syndicate that buys valley crystals, runs the ridge-road caravans and cliff-lifts, and sells brim-coal at eye-watering markups to towns that can't let their ring go out.
The civic and religious order that runs the night shifts, tends the brazier rings, and rings the Sunset Bells. They treat keeping the Mist at bay as sacred duty against the spirits below.
The gleaming ridge city-state directly above Rattleguard. Home to the sky-docks, portals, and absurdly expensive apartments you could no longer afford.

An industrial quarry city-state on the southern ridge. Caravans take four days to reach it by the ridge-road; only the desperate and the criminal sprint a full day straight across the valley floor. Always feuding with Highspire over crystal tariffs.

A cliff-cave smugglers' city-state perched on a lone western peak the ridge-road never reaches. No tariffs, no questions asked, and a thriving black market for anything salvaged below the mistline. Its runners make their living on the valley sprints honest caravans won't risk.
A walled abbey city-state on the northern plateau housing the oldest pre-Mist archives and the Lamplighters' main seminary.

missions.name: The Last Bell of Tarnhollow
missions.description:
Rattleguard's warding bell is cracked. When it goes, the night shift loses the one sound everyone on the ring can hear over the Mist.

There's a bell big enough to replace it hanging in **Tarnhollow**, a walled town up the valley that went dark years ago. Nobody knows why its ring failed. Walk in at dawn, get the bell down, and get it home. It's heavy, it's loud, and the valley notices noise.

**Be back behind the braziers before dark. There is nowhere else to be.**

missions.name: The Sunken Lime-Kiln
missions.description: Miners working a limestone quarry down-fjord broke into an old sealed kiln and saw Mist lying in the bottom of it at noon. They left in a hurry. Recover their abandoned crystal crates and survey ledger before a rival crew claims them.

missions.name: The Highspire Lift-Gate
missions.description: The Crystal Cartel hiked the tariff on the cliff-lift up to Highspire overnight, stranding three Rattleguard wagons at the bottom. Broker a deal with the lift-warden, forge a Cartel transit seal, or find out what they're actually trying to keep off the ridge.

missions.name: First Salvage on the Gilded Moth
missions.description: A small sky-skiff out of Crow's Ledge clipped the mist-trees in the western gorge at dawn and went down intact in the valley floor. It's a full day's push there and back—get the cargo manifest and any intact crystals before sunset or before Crow's Ledge sends its own cleaners.
